name: Knomadic
description: Adds rounded corners to all windows in GNOME Shell, including apps that don't use libadwaita/libhandy. GPU-accelerated GLSL shader with squircle support, custom borders/shadows, and per-app settings. Personal fork of Rounded Window Corners, forked to be self-contained (own UUID, no dependency on the upstream repo/extensions.gnome.org still existing). custom-shadow left off on Asahi (no GPU); safe to enable on machines with real GPU acceleration.
